values.title: Delete webhook
values.summary: Stop deliveries and delete a webhook.
values.body:
DELETE

/v1/webhooks/{webhook_id}

Deletes the webhook. Deliveries already in flight still complete.

### Authorizations

**Authorization string required**

Bearer token. Use a server key or a user access token: Bearer <token>.

### Path parameters

**webhook_id string required**

The webhook to delete.

### Errors

**401 unauthorized**

The token is missing, expired or revoked.

**404 not_found**

No webhook exists with this ID in the environment.

```
curl --request DELETE \
```
